about: At age 68, Naprosyn overlaps with Coversyl and the record shows no supply of a diuretic within 60 days either side of the NSAID supply.
At age 72, naproxen overlaps with candesartan and the record shows no supply of a diuretic within 60 days either side of the NSAID supply.
Indapamide covers the full naproxen course from 2025-10-08 to 2025-10-10, so there is no finding.
